companion.disclaimer: An AI reads what you write here and answers it. It can be wrong — for anything about money or access, ask support.
companion.emptyBody: Write down what you are working on — you will get a response to it.

companion.offNoApiKey: There is no provider key in the .env for the "companion" task (config/ai-models.json). In the terminal: node run.mjs ai-check
